requirements.title: DSHIFTR argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I and J shall be integer or BOZ literal constants with matching integer kinds when both are integer, shall not both be BOZ literals, and SHIFT shall be an integer in the permitted nonnegative BIT_SIZE range for DSHIFTR.

requirements.title: DSHIFTR result characteristics follow the integer operand
requirements.definition: The result of DSHIFTR has the same type and kind as I when I is integer, otherwise the same type and kind as J.

requirements.title: DSHIFTR converts a BOZ operand as INT to the other integer kind
requirements.definition: If either I or J is a BOZ literal constant, DSHIFTR first converts it as if by INT to integer with the kind type parameter of the other operand.

requirements.title: DSHIFTR result bit composition and intrinsic equivalence
requirements.definition: The DSHIFTR result is formed from shifted bits of I and J and is equal to IOR(SHIFTL(I,BIT_SIZE(I)-SHIFT), SHIFTR(J,SHIFT)); the integer-as-bits model is the one in 16.3.
